scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Do you want to build connections without being in a guild?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
想找伙伴一起冒险，却不想加入公会吗？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Can't find the perfect guild for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
找不到适合自己的公会吗？

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
You can join or leave clans freely! Just join!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
加入或退出氏族都很自由！快来加入吧！

scripts.text:
[Clan Helper]
Now, come on in and meet the masters of the Kingdom's best clans!
scripts.translation:
[氏族助手]
快进来认识一下王国各大氏族的族长吧！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hi! I'm Raffam, master of the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你好！我是拉法姆，卢恩·米德加兹王国^3131FF剑氏族^000000的族长。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族信息

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Sword Clan
scripts.translation: 关于剑氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are a type of guild ran by the Kingdom.
They don't participate in the Siege, so members are free to join/leave anytime.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000是由王国管理的一种组织，不同于参与攻城战的公会，因此成员可以随时加入或退出。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
I wish we could join the Siege. I'd love flying over on my dragon and burning everyone in my way!
Oops, too thrilled!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
真希望我们也能参加攻城战。我好想骑着龙飞过去，把挡路的人都烧光！
哎呀，我太激动了！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Join us, if no Clan suits your taste.
New members are given ^3131FFfree stat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
如果还没找到合心意的氏族，就加入我们吧。
新成员可以免费获得^3131FF属性加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Melee stats are offered as the name ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 suggests, but not all members are Melee classes.
Don't feel pressured, just count on me!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
正如^3131FF剑氏族^000000的名字所示，我们提供近战属性加成，不过成员不一定都得是近战职业。
别有压力，交给我就好！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Differences in variety creates the fun.
These odd bunches never bore me in the party.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
正因为成员各不相同，组队才有意思。
和这群有趣的家伙一起冒险，从来不会无聊。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
And who knows you might meet your soul mate in the Clan? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
说不定你还能在氏族里遇到心仪的对象呢？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
The ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 mainly supports Melee adventurers.
Join for free ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF剑氏族^000000主要帮助近战冒险者。
免费加入即可获得^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Remember, no Siege participation.
You should contact other guilds for Siege.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
记住，氏族不参加攻城战。
想参加攻城战的话，请联系其他公会。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
A question?
Excited to join me? Hahah!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
有什么想问的吗？
已经迫不及待想加入我这边了吗？哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Oh, you'll join? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哦，你要加入？眼光不错！
我们先看看氏族规章，再开始办理入会手续。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
新成员可以获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
到这里都明白了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Clan masters exist for reason, like I.
Understood?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过两周^000000没有登录，就会被^FF0000除名^000000。
这就是族长存在的意义，比如我。
明白了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Great, sign your name here to register.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
很好，请在这里签名，完成登记。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
So, you're ^3131FF{0}^000000! Nice name!
Let me register you.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
原来你叫^3131FF{0}^000000！名字不错！
我来帮你登记。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Come back to join after you leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
请先退出当前公会，再回来申请加入。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Eh? Oh, you're in a Clan.
Don't mess with me, it's not cool!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
咦？你已经加入氏族了。
别拿我开玩笑，这可不好玩！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Welcome to the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000!
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
At your service!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
欢迎加入^3131FF剑氏族^000000！
按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000即可查看氏族信息。
随时听候差遣！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哎呀，那我们从头再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
哎呀，那我们从头再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
You want to leave?
No problem. I hope you'll find a more suitable Clan.
Ready for withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你想退出吗？
没问题，希望你能找到更合适的氏族。
确定要退出吗？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Wait, you're not with us! Grr, don't make me breathe fire at you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
等等，你根本不是我们氏族的！哼，别逼我朝你喷火！

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Hey, talk to your guild master if you want to leave.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
嘿，想退出公会的话，去找公会会长谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Okay, it's done. But let's not be strangers, okay?
It was nice having you!
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
好了，手续办完了。以后有空常来，好吗？
很高兴你曾是我们的一员！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
I'm Devon, master of the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
我是德文，^3131FF奥术之杖氏族^000000的族长。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族信息

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Arc Wand Clan
scripts.translation: 关于奥术之杖氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are ran by the Kingdom, not privately like others.
And I manage one of them.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000由王国管理，不像其他公会那样由私人经营。
我负责管理其中一个氏族。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
What's with that look? You got a problem?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...
你这是什么表情？你有意见吗？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Brother, you're scaring a potential member, be nice.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
弟弟，你吓到有意加入的人了，客气一点。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Join if you are seeking a place to fit in. We give ^3131FFfree bonus stats^000000. But no Siege participation.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
想找个归属的话，就加入我们吧。我们提供^3131FF免费的属性加成^000000，不过不能参加攻城战。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Most members are offensive Mage classes as the name ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 suggests, but that's no requirement.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
正如^3131FF奥术之杖氏族^000000的名字所示，大多数成员都是擅长进攻的魔法师，不过这不是加入条件。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hey, Shaam Rumi.
Stop hitting on my brother and get to work.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...喂，沙姆·鲁米。
别缠着我弟弟了，快去工作。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
随便你！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...Hmpf!
Listen, Crossbow Clan's master is evil.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...哼！
听着，十字弓氏族的族长不是好人。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Get over me, Devon! Don't spread rumors!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
少管我，德文！别散布谣言！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Haha. Stop it. You two are making a scene.
Come on, back to work guys.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哈哈，你们俩别吵了，都引人围观了。
好了，大家继续工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
The ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 mainly supports offensive Mage classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members. Don't ask for more; it's the Kingdom's rule.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF奥术之杖氏族^000000主要帮助擅长进攻的魔法师。
新成员可获得^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。别嫌少，这是王国的规定。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 can't participate in the Siege.
If you like the Siege, then go join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
喜欢攻城战的话，就去加入普通公会。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That is all. No questions.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
就这些，没什么好问的。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
...
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...
那我们先看看氏族规章，再开始办理入会手续。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
You with me so far?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
新成员可获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
听明白了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过两周^000000没有登录，就会被^FF0000除名^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Sign your name here.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
在这里签名。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000.....
Good, let me invite you in.

[Devon Aire]
Leave your guild first to join my Clan, duh.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
想加入我的氏族，就先退出公会，笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're already in a Clan. You joking?!
Oh, I can be funny, too--FIRE PILLAR!
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已经加入氏族了，还开这种玩笑？！
哦，我也会开玩笑——火柱攻击！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You have joined the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已加入^3131FF奥术之杖氏族^000000。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
So don't bother me later.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000查看氏族信息。
以后别再来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
That's all. Visit often or be expelled. Dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
就这样。记得常来，否则就等着被除名。散会。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Then I don't want you.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
那我可不想收你。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Gosh, listen to the policy again.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
真是的，把规章再听一遍。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Want to leave, huh?
I understand, it's about Sieges. If not, why are..Never mind..
I'll process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
想退出啊？
我懂，是因为攻城战吧。要不是这个原因...算了...
我来帮你办理退出。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
Naughty children deserve a good Jupitel Thunder.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
不听话的孩子，就该尝尝雷鸣术！

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You're barking up the wrong tree. Go to your Clan master.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你找错人了，去找你们的族长。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You are withdrawn from the Clan.
Now leave. I don't feel like talking anymore.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你已退出氏族。
现在走吧，我不想再跟你说话。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Nice to meet you. I'm Berman Aire, master of the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
I'm also the older brother of Devon Aire. Devon looks tough, but he's kind hearted.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
很高兴认识你。我是伯曼·艾尔，^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000的族长。
我也是德文·艾尔的哥哥。德文看起来凶巴巴的，其实心地很善良。

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族信息

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Golden Mace Clan
scripts.translation: 关于黄金之锤氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFClans^000000 are established by the Kingdom to help adventurers connect and share information.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族^000000由王国设立，帮助冒险者互相结识、交流情报。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Because the Kingdom runs the Clan, there is no Siege participation, but at least the members are given ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
The stat bonuses are small, but can be very useful for beginning adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
氏族由王国管理，因此不能参加攻城战，不过成员至少能获得^3131FF属性加成^000000。
加成虽然不多，对刚踏上旅途的冒险者却很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
We're named the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000, but we don't discriminate against applicants based on their classes.
The name is just to help you easily choose your Clan.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
我们叫^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000，但不会因为申请者的职业而区别对待。
这个名字只是方便你挑选氏族。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Berman, enough with the explanation. Let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
伯曼，别说教了。我们去格拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
... Hey.
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
...喂。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, you're scaring me.
Berman, call me when you can!~
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
哎呀，吓到我了。
伯曼，有空记得来找我哦！~

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Hah hah, I apologize for their bickering.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哈哈，抱歉，他们俩总是拌嘴。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you have a question?
If you're tired of traveling alone, join us! You can join and leave the Clan anytime you want.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
有什么想问的吗？
如果你厌倦了独自冒险，就加入我们吧！你可以随时加入或退出氏族。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
The ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000 mainly helps supportive classes.
We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000主要帮助辅助型职业。
新成员可获得^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
As I told you earlier, Clans cannot join the Siege because they already belong to the Kingdom.
If you want to be in the Siege, then I recommend you join a regular guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
正如我刚才所说，氏族隶属于王国，因此不能参加攻城战。
如果你想参加攻城战，我建议你加入普通公会。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Do you understand what the Clans are about now?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
现在你明白氏族是怎么回事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Great!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
太好了！
那我们先看看氏族规章，再开始办理入会手续。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
作为新成员，你将获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you agree to maintain good standing in the Clan?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过两周^000000没有登录，就会被^FF0000除名^000000。
你愿意遵守氏族规矩吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Now, please write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
请在这里写下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
^3131FF{0}^000000! What a good name!
Okay, then...

[Berman Aire]
Oh, no.
In order to join, you first have to leave your current guild.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
哦，不行。
要加入氏族，你得先退出当前公会。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You're already in a Clan.
You're just confused, right?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你已经加入一个氏族了。
你只是弄糊涂了吧？

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Welcome to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
欢迎加入^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000即可查看氏族信息。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
Please remember the few precautions I gave you, and enjoy your Clan activities!
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
记住我刚才提醒你的几件事，祝你在氏族活动中玩得开心！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
With meeting, there is parting.
I hope you enjoyed your time in the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
Now, should I process your withdrawal?
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
天下没有不散的筵席。
希望你在^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000过得愉快。
现在要为你办理退出手续吗？

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
You can't leave the Clan without joining it first.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
你还没加入氏族，当然不能退出。

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
I'm sorry, but I can't remove you from another Clan...
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
抱歉，我不能把你从其他氏族除名...

scripts.text:
[Berman Aire]
It's processed.
Come back anytime to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000. I'll be here.
scripts.translation:
[伯曼·艾尔]
手续办好了。
随时欢迎回到^3131FF黄金之锤氏族^000000，我会一直在这里。

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Hi, there! I'm Shaam, master of the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你好！我是沙姆，^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000的族长。
有什么可以帮你？

scripts.text: Clan Information
scripts.translation: 氏族信息

scripts.text: Join.
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: What are Clans?
scripts.translation: 什么是氏族？

scripts.text: About the Crossbow Clan
scripts.translation: 关于十字弓氏族

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans were established by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to...
Raffam, why were our ^3131FFclans^000000 made?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
卢恩·米德加兹王国建立氏族是为了...
拉法姆，我们的^3131FF氏族^000000究竟是做什么的？

scripts.text:
[Raffam Oranpere]
Did you sleep in class? Gosh.
The Clans help lone adventurers connect with each other and share information.
scripts.translation:
[拉法姆·奥兰佩尔]
你上课睡着了吗？真是的。
氏族是为了让独自冒险的人彼此结识、分享情报。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
A-ha, got it! Thank you, Captain!
You heard that too, right?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
啊哈，懂了！谢谢你，船长！
你也听到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Run by the Kingdom itself, the Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege, but the good news is that the members are given some ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
氏族由王国直接管理，因此不能参加攻城战。不过好消息是，成员能获得一些^3131FF属性加成^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
In case you wonder if the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 only recruits Archers, no, it doesn't.
All the Clans accept all classes. You can choose the one that suits your needs best.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你可能会好奇^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000是不是只收弓箭手；答案是否定的。
所有氏族都接纳各类职业，你可以选最适合自己的那个。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
That should cover everything there is to know.
Berman, let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
该说的都说完了。
伯曼，我们去格拉斯特海姆逛逛吧。

scripts.text:
[Devon Aire]
You...
scripts.translation:
[德文·艾尔]
你...

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ooh, scary! You're so protective of your brother.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
哇，好可怕！你可真护着你哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 is ideal for ranged classes.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000最适合远程职业。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, let me check the Clan manual. Ah, and we offer stat bonuses to new members: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
嗯，我查一下氏族手册。对了，新成员还能获得属性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
The Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege; you should join a private guild instead for Siege.
The Clans are for adventurers that hate being tied down.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
氏族不能参加攻城战；想参加的话，就加入普通公会吧。
氏族适合不喜欢受拘束的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Do you have a question?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Oh, yeah? Good choice!
Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
哦，是吗？眼光不错！
那我们先看看氏族规章，再开始办理入会手续。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FFClansmen^000000 cannot participate in the Siege.
As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF氏族成员^000000不能参加攻城战。
作为新成员，你将获得以下属性加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。
你同意吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
Do you promise you'll maintain good standing?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你可以随时加入或退出氏族，但如果^FF0000超过两周^000000没有登录，就会被^FF0000除名^000000。
你保证会遵守氏族规矩吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Good, write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
好，在这里写下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
^3131FF{0}^000000..!
Ugh, your penmanship needs work. Let me process your application.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
^3131FF{0}^000000...！
啧，你的字得多练练。我来帮你处理申请。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Did you finish things up with your guild?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你和原公会的事情都处理好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Eh, you're already in a Clan. Hey, this isn't funny.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
咦，你已经加入氏族了。这可不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Welcome to the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
欢迎加入^3131FF十字弓氏族^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
按^3131FFCtrl+G^000000即可查看氏族信息。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Don't pick fights with other clansmen. Be social.
If you need help, you can always whisper me, okay? See you around!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
别和其他氏族成员起冲突，大家友好相处。
需要帮忙的话，随时密语我，好吗？回头见！

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
All right then. I'm just going to go have some fun.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
那我先去玩啦。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Ah, do you need time to think about this? No problem.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
啊，你还需要时间考虑吗？没问题。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Why, did you find a better Clan?
I'm disappointed, but it's your call. Let me process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
怎么，找到更合适的氏族了？
我有点失望，不过这是你的选择。我来帮你办理退出。

scripts.text: Continue.
scripts.translation: 继续

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
I can't let you leave--you're not even in my Clan!
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
你根本没加入我的氏族，我可不能让你退出！

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
Sorry, but I don't meddle with other Clans' business.
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
抱歉，别的氏族的事我不插手。

scripts.text:
[Shaam Rumi]
It's done.
If you ever miss us, don't hesitate to come back, alright?
scripts.translation:
[沙姆·鲁米]
手续办好了。
以后想我们了，就随时回来，好吗？

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个错误。
